thread.title: TSX May Open Lower As Oil Prices Fall, iPhone Demand Concerns Hit Tech Stocks

author: MT Newswires
title: TSX May Open Lower As Oil Prices Fall, iPhone Demand Concerns Hit Tech Stocks
text:
Shutterstock photo Canada's benchmark index looked set for a second day of losses after oil prices weakened and concerns over the demand for Apple's ( AAPL ) iPhone resulted in a selloff of global tech stocks.
Stock futures for the December quarter for the S&P TSX index were down 0.2% recently.
The Wall Street Journal said Monday that Apple is cutting its production of all three of its new iPhone models that were introduced in September.
Meanwhile, Action Economics said supply uncertainty has driven oil prices in both directions lately, with OPEC's push for a 1.4 million barrels of oil per day production cut providing support. US production meanwhile, remains at or near record levels, as US waivers on exports have kept Iranian barrels on the market, both bearish factors. OPEC and Russia will meet on Dec. 6 to discuss output, although so far, Russia remains non-committal on cutting back its production.
The TSX lost 84 points on Monday, dragged down by tech and healthcare stocks.
